items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: The boy Presley Goff, he used to be down on Tulu Street... He played music too, you know.

ctx.x: Do you have any lessons on clarinet? Anybody help you?
The boy Presley Goff, he used to be down on Tulu Street, he's in Tibbetul. He played music too, you know. Presley Goff.
And he helped you some with the clarinet?
